sloka: परितुष्टा हि सा देवि वन वासम् गते मयि ।राजानम् न अतिशन्केत मिथ्या वादी इति धार्मिकम् ॥२-५२-६२॥
transliteration: parituṣṭā hi sā devi vana vāsam gate mayi ।rājānam na atiśanketa mithyā vādī iti dhārmikam ॥2-52-62॥

translations.english: If queen Kaikeyi is fully satisfied that I have gone to dwell in the forest, she will no longer have any doubt and will believe that righteous king Dasaratha is not a liar.
